csvText.title: CSV content
csvText.description: Paste supplied product data, maximum 5 MB UTF-8, 10000 records and 30 columns.

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Select the actual CSV field separator. It is not inferred from the file.

skuColumn.title: SKU column
skuColumn.description: Exact case-sensitive header containing the product identifier; leading zeros are preserved.

requiredColumns.title: Required columns
requiredColumns.description: Exact headers that must exist and contain a nonblank value in each data record.

priceColumns.title: Price columns
priceColumns.description: Exact headers to check for nonnegative plain decimal prices. Selected prices must not be blank.

decimalSeparator.title: Decimal separator
decimalSeparator.description: Select the price decimal separator. Currency symbols and thousands separators are not accepted.
